purpose: Check whether a selected structure was limited by the short 512-step inner fit, rather than treating short-fit failure as structural impossibility.
rules: Select one structure per task and method by the original selection BCE only.
Restart numeric or shadow values six times; keep the chosen masks/codebooks fixed.
Use each original SGD learning rate twice; same new seeds and data for all methods.
Select checkpoint/restart using selection BCE; evaluate on a fresh independent sample after all refits.
This is a diagnostic extension after looking at source search progress, not a preregistered new-task comparison.
